WeissTechnik｜Specimen Transfer type Cold Thermal Shock Chamber
ShockEvent
ShockEvent is an international standard-compliant thermal shock tester developed by WeissTechnik. It reproduces instantaneous temperature changes under a wide range of conditions from -80°C to +220°C by using a sample transfer system with a high-temperature chamber and a low-temperature chamber. Thermal stresses applied to electronic components and materials can be accurately evaluated. High load capacity, defrost-free operation, and energy-saving design ensure both efficiency and reliability. Furthermore, it complies with environmental regulations by using low GWP refrigerant R449A. With a wide variety of models and intuitive operability, this next-generation solution meets the testing needs of diverse industries such as automotive, electronics, and aerospace.

Product Features
Sample transfer type structure
By switching between high and low temperature chambers in a short period of time, specimens are subjected to instantaneous temperature changes to realize highly reproducible cold thermal shock testing.
Defrost-free operation
The unique mechanism enables continuous operation of more than 1,000 cycles, eliminating the need for test interruption due to defrosting.
Independent use of high and low temperature tanks
Each chamber can be used as an independent chamber and can be utilized not only for thermal shock testing but also for independent high or low temperature testing.
Robust construction
The test chamber is made of highly corrosion-resistant stainless steel to maintain stable performance even with rapid temperature changes and long-term operation. Product Features
